stemMd: Why is Shore’s600GB included allowance insufficient by itself to determine feasibility?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The offer permits extra traffic without a volume limit.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The plan is free whenever used as backup

options.label: C
options.textMd: The backup only needs half the forecast

options.label: D
options.textMd: The forecast is actually less than600GB

explanationMd: An included allowance is not necessarily a hard capacity ceiling. The extra-traffic term makes900GB feasible at an additional cost.

distractorRationale.e: The offers explicitly have different providers.
distractorRationale.c: The policy requires full forecast capacity.
